articles.title: Qubic restarts blockchain, opens recovery claims after $1.4M hack
articles.snippet: The network’s validators approved a recovery plan and opened claims until May 1, 2027.

articles.title: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company
articles.snippet: Derek Brown likened the prediction market company to a “public nuisance“ that was “causing a significant and substantial ongoing harm“ to state residents.

articles.title: Bitwise, Hyperliquid seek SEC rule changes for token trading, airdrops
articles.snippet: The firms are seeking clearer guidance on the classification of crypto assets and secondary-market trading as the SEC’s public comment period comes to a close.

articles.title: UK Banks Hit With 10,000 Complaints Over Blocked Crypto Transfers in 90 Days: Report
articles.snippet: Lloyds drew the most complaints despite having no published policy restricting crypto transfers, according to a Stand With Crypto report.

articles.title: Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs Join Growing List of Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
articles.snippet: Sixteen companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, up from nine just four days earlier, according to an updated public notice.
